$comment: Projects from LinkedIn/CV. First one is featured (large card); the rest are expandable rows in this order.

items.title: EspressoDay
items.summary: Ordering and loyalty app for EspressoDay, a chain of 130 coffee shops in Kazakhstan: menu, order ahead, bonuses and a loyalty card in one place. On the App Store.
highlights: Built internal modules of the app in React Native and TypeScript.
Contributed to an architecture that lets new locations be added without rebuilding the product.
Code review and bug fixing before every release.

items.title: FBSM Live
items.summary: Live-commerce marketplace for Fashion Brand Square, a South Korean retail holding: people watch live streams and buy straight from them. In production for 5,000+ users, distributed privately (B2B), so it is not in the public stores.
highlights: Integrated the EPAY payment gateway: secure transactions for 5,000+ active users.
Built live streaming and real-time chat: +30% engagement during sales events.
Optimised REST requests and added caching: screens open about 20% faster.

items.title: Qarqyn
items.summary: Trivia and brain-training game on the App Store: 1-on-1 duels with opponent matching, rating and ranks, a character that evolves with your level. Content in Kazakh and Russian.
highlights: Match flow: category selection, automatic opponent matching, timed duel on synchronised questions.
Rating and rank progression, match history, rematches.

items.title: EchoID — thesis project
items.summary: Digital identity system on zero-knowledge proofs: a user proves their age or employer without revealing the document itself. Defended with top marks at Astana IT University.

items.title: TrainAut
items.summary: Mobile app for parents of children with autism. Led development from requirements to release, designed the interface, integrated third-party SDKs.

items.title: MAMAN FEST 2025
items.summary: National exhibition and job fair with 130+ companies, attended by the President of Kazakhstan. Organisation, partners, hackathons for students.
